alternatives.option: a URL-rewrite operation on stored entries

context: Added read-only raw-file route (/api/raw, root-jailed, text/plain+nosniff), /api/repo-info render-time remote link derivation, repo-path linkification, and a needs-human filter toggle to the Triage dashboard. Spec §8 amended; 22 new tests; 1423 green.

summary: Chose render-time link derivation (local /api/raw link authoritative + best-effort remote blob link from /api/repo-info) over a URL-rewrite operation on stored entries
